Daily Devotional

November 1

4 Surely he hath borne our griefs, and carried our sorrows: yet we did esteem him stricken, smitten of God, and afflicted. (Isaiah 53:4 KJV)

Jesus didn’t die for His own grief’s and sorrows, but He died for ours. He was the perfect sinless Son of God, and did not have any reason of His own, that He should be crucified. It is the most wonderful expression of love in the history of the world that Jesus would take on our sins, grief’s, and sorrows, that we could be made the righteousness of God through His sacrifice (Romans 3:22). When you realize just what Jesus did for you, so that you could again have fellowship with Him and the Father (John 17:3), how can you not love Him with all your heart, and want to serve Him.

The words “griefs” and “sorrows” was clarified by Matthew (Matthew 8:17), where he quoted this scripture by Isaiah and changed the word griefs to infirmities and the word sorrows to sicknesses, showing that Jesus died for our healing as well as our sins and deliverance. If you do a word study of the Greek words that were translated griefs (CHOLIY) and sorrows (MAKOB) you will find that the interpretation by Matthew was correct. Jesus truly bore our sicknesses in His body that we might be made well, and healed of any sicknesses and diseases. Pastors that teach that healing is not for us today are not telling the truth, as Jesus provided for our healing in His atonement, and for us to ignore that, is not pleasing to God at all. Maybe Pastors should study the Word of God a little bit, and discover the truth of the Gospel. Or, just maybe, most Pastors just don’t want to have to show any power, or signs following (Mark 16:20), in their preaching. Or maybe they really are not called to be a pastor, and don’t have the gifts of the Holy Spirit in them. Why anyone would have the power of God in them, and not want to demonstrate it, is hard to understand. If Jesus needed healing to attract people, then we do also. Thank you Jesus for all you have given us!

If you would like to come and try it out, the entry fee is 250 bits, or 0.00025 BTC (0.18 USD, roughly). The bits are put into the "bank" which can then be won by other players. At the moment, the maximum bet is 100 bits (0.07 USD), but the max bet can be raised if more people start playing.

How it works

A random number between 0-100 is generated. Players then bet BTC on whether or not the next random number will be higher or lower than the last one. Your winnings will change depending on how likely it is for the number to be higher/lower than the last one.

Example:

  • The last number generated was 30.
  • There is a 30% chance of the next number being lower, and a 70% chance of it being higher.
  • If you bet on it being higher, you will get a return of 30% on your bet, but if you bet on it being lower, you will get a 70% return because it is less likely to be lower.
  • If the same number is drawn twice, everybody loses. This creates a very small house edge of 0.1%.
